name: @hydra/dsh-fleet-tasks
description: Prototype: the V3 flagship — a shared task queue (create/claim/complete/cancel/escalate/accept) with goal ancestry (#28), a fixed workflow-state taxonomy (Triage/Backlog/Unstarted/Started/Completed/Cancelled, #28), single-assignee atomic claims with execution locks, severity-routed escalation (P0/P1/P2 + owner + nextAction, #28), artifact contracts with false-done rejection, and the heartbeat-wake claim seam (claimWake) for the fleet-scheduler. Registers ctx.fleetTasks + the task_create / task_list / task_claim / task_complete / task_escalate / task_accept tools. Issue #26.
